name: Dashboard wireframe
description: A SaaS dashboard wireframe at desktop size: top bar, side navigation, filter row, KPI tiles, a line chart, an activity list and an orders table, with numbered notes on what to replace.

runs.t: A SaaS analytics dashboard at 1440 px wide. Replace the example names and numbers with your product's, and follow the numbered notes on the right.
Last 30 days, compared with the 30 days before. Updated 2 minutes ago.
Jonas Weber joined the Pro plan
Logo, global search, notifications and the account menu. Nothing else: put page actions in the page header.
5 to 7 sections, current page highlighted. Keep Settings and Help at the bottom. Rename the items to your own sections.
The filters that change every number below. Default to the range people use most; show a Reset link once one is set.
3 to 5 numbers people check daily, each with a comparison. Green means good, so flip it for cost metrics.
Swap the line for your trend. Label units on the axis, keep gridlines light and show the exact value on hover.
The latest 5 events, newest first, linking to the item. Show an empty state ('Nothing yet') for new accounts.
5 to 8 rows with sort and search, and a link to the full list. Right-align numbers and colour the status text.
